section.integration_notes: - MarketUpdate.tsx wraps content in PageThemeProvider and MarketUpdateProvider for global state - Tab1_SelectTopics fetches topics (last 14 days), earnings (next 7 days), and macro events; stores selections in context - Tab2_GenerateEdit uses useEffect to auto-trigger content generation on mount; provides section editor UI - Tab3_ExportSave handles draft save (to DynamoDB) and PowerPoint export (S3 presigned URL with browser download) - All API calls routed through market-update.ts endpoint definitions - React Query handles caching and error/loading states for data fetch operations - Context provides computed properties for selectedTopics/selectedEarnings/selectedEvents by filtering fetched data - InstructionsPanel explains 3-step workflow: Select → Generate & Edit → Export - Sections are: 1. "What Happened Last Week?" 2. "Key Events This Week" 3. "Impact on Client Portfolios"

shared_patterns.pattern: Both pages use useTabNavigation hook with TabNavigation UI component for tab-based workflows

CausalityEngine and MarketUpdate both feature interactive bubble visualizations (different implementations) - CausalityEngine: Single container, grid-based positioning with jitter, sentiment colors, relevance sizing - MarketUpdate: Dual-side (bearish left/bullish right), random positioning with overlap detection, article count sizing
CausalityEngine uses Zustand for local state, MarketUpdate uses React Context for global state Both use React Query v5 for data fetching with caching and background refetching
All API calls abstracted in endpoint files (causality-endpoints.ts, market-update.ts) Allows environment-specific URL configuration (VITE_CAUSALITY_API_URL env var)
Both pages use sonner library for loading/success/error toasts during mutations
CausalityEngine: Stores filters (timeRange, sentiment, sector) + selected theme IDs in Zustand MarketUpdate: Stores selected item IDs (topics, earnings, events) in React Context
CausalityEngine SelectedThemesPanel shows selected themes with aggregate stats MarketUpdate SelectedItemsPanel shows selected items from all three data sources
